sam_3_3d_body.label: model
sam_3_3d_body.description: Reconstruct human body shape and pose as a GLB model from one image

DeveloperAPIMediaInput.description:
An IMAGE media reference. `type` is optional and defaults to 'media_input'.

The default is injected in a `before` validator (not just the field default) so it
survives the `exclude_unset` dump in `validate_developer_api_params` — a caller can
pass just `{"id": ...}`. Pass an explicit `type` (e.g. a prior generation's job
type) to chain from an existing generation instead of an upload.

id.description: Media id: a UUID from media_upload or a prior generation.
id.title: Id

type.description: Image input type — 'media_input' for an uploaded image; or a prior generation's job type to chain from it.
type.title: Type

DeveloperAPIMediaInput.title: DeveloperAPIMediaInput

image_references.description: One source image containing people, followed by an optional binary mask image (white=person, black=background).
image_references.title: Image References

export_meshes.description: Ask the provider to export individual PLY meshes for detected people.
export_meshes.title: Export Meshes

include_3d_keypoints.description: Include 3D keypoint markers in the returned GLB model.
include_3d_keypoints.title: Include 3D Keypoints

include_mhr_params.description: Ask the provider to calculate full Meta Human Representation metadata.
include_mhr_params.title: Include Mhr Params

kimodo.label: model
kimodo.description: Generate a timed 3D motion sequence from text prompts as an NPZ file

enhancer.description: Split one motion request into a timed scene plan before generation.
enhancer.title: Enhancer

prompt.description: Motion request to split when enhancer is enabled.
prompt.title: Prompt

duration.description: Exact total duration in seconds when enhancer is enabled.
duration.title: Duration

prompts.description: Ordered motion prompts, one prompt per timeline segment.
prompts.title: Prompts

durations.description: Segment durations in seconds, one positive value per prompt.
durations.title: Durations

model_version.description: Kimodo model variant. H8 reacts to a new prompt sooner.
model_version.title: Model Version

seed.description: Seed used to make generation reproducible.
seed.title: Seed

rules.cel: params.enhancer ? (type(params.prompt) == string && type(params.duration) == double && type(params.prompts) == null_type && type(params.durations) == null_type) : (type(params.prompt) == null_type && type(params.duration) == null_type && type(params.prompts) == list && type(params.durations) == list)
rules.message: use prompt and duration with enhancer, or prompts and durations without it
prompts and durations must have the same length
